fusions.name: Sticky Lash
fusions.desc: Lashes out a sticky line of mesh up to 5 tiles, dealing 5 damage, up to 1.2 times that at full reach, and slowing the target by 20% for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Plunge from the Reeds
fusions.desc: You spring up and come down in a dripping mesh, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaving each [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Lily-Pad Snarl
fusions.desc: Lays a sticky mesh 5 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward; anything struck moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Toad in the Rigging
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded toad that rides your mesh and lashes enemies within 5 tiles with its tongue, striking for 4 damage and slowing them by 15% for 2 seconds.
